segments.text: The unofficial leader of the Go-Getters Club. No matter the problem, Reycho thinks hard about how it can be solved and will never give up. He's known for his physical ability, but occasionally runs into situations headfirst. He's childish in both good ways and bad, completely devoid of negativity, embodying the pure innocence of a child. However, he's completely oblivious to girls.
From official site
Reycho is actually a remote-controlled robot operated by Pochi, making Pochi the true protagonist of World's End Club.

Vanilla is the innocent but scatterbrained and ditsy heroine. She tends to say things that seriously lack self-awareness, so the others will simply ignore her. Although she seems to be uninterested in what's going on, she actually has a very sharp mind. She is very quick to catch on to adult conspiracies.
From official site

Initially believed to be the ghost of Vanilla, who passed away before the start of the game, she is the mastermind behind the Game of Fate, a fake Death Game created to break the brainwashing controlling her friends.
Is revealed to be alive but comatose, using her ability of astral projection to appear to her friends as a spirit.

Passionate, hot-headed, and impulsive, Kansai loves the idea of strong, brave leaders, and tries to take command of the group. Even when things go bad due to his carelessness, he has a certain charm that makes it impossible to hate him. He sees Reycho as his arch-rival, causing sparks to fly at times. On his chest, Kansai wears the "Leader's Badge," which is only given to a true leader. As you can tell from his appearance, he loves baseball.

Whatever Chuko lacks in height she makes up for with her tough personality. She has a fiery temperament, aggressive nature, a whip-like tongue, and isn't afraid of anyone she comes across. She makes quick decisions, moves with purpose, and hates waiting. Chuko may just seem impatient, but is very talented and works hard for the sake of the group. Although she hates spicy food, as it can make her tear up, she will pretend it doesn't bother her just to save face.

Mowchan is a gentle, quiet boy who seldom gets angry, avoids conflict, and is a bit of a coward. He loves to eat and is known to indiscriminately follow the aroma of food when he's hungry, even if it results in getting him lost. Not only does he like to eat, but he's also a food expert who often displays his culinary knowledge.

Nyoro is a logical thinker and doesn't like inefficiency or irrational actions. However, she's considerate and doesn't distance herself from her classmates. She's composed and rarely gets upset. As the daughter of a well-respected scientist, her subjects of choice are science and math, but her passion lies in fashion, and she's the admirer of a certain nationally acclaimed artist.

Aniki is cold and hardly speaks or opens up to anyone. He's got a bad attitude, purposely isolates himself from everyone else, and he seems to carry a hidden dark past that shrouds him in a veil of mystery. There was a time when Aniki was a generous boy that was popular among his classmates, but now he's very harsh on himself and just as harsh on his friends.

Pai is as soft and gentle in her personality as she is physically. She's certainly not fat! She's of average weight, slender, graceful, and has skin not unlike a marshmallow. Overflowing with tolerance for others and filled with compassion, she is like a loving saint, and as amiable as the ocean. She is a kind mother to the group and easy to love.

Tattsun is the embodiment of "Seriousness" and "Discipline" (with a capital "S" and a capital "D"). As a law-abiding goody two-shoes, even if the reason is legitimate, rule breaking is rule breaking, and he will always say his piece. He longs to be a strong, upright superhero of justice with a serious personality, just like the heroes from his favorite show, "The Electro Rangers," whom he idolizes. When he sees an injustice, he'll reference the Electro Rangers, starting a long lecture and distracting everybody.

Pochi is awkward, introverted, passive, and tends to mutter when he speaks. He always has his head down, staring at his game console. He is very guarded and seldom shows his true self, but not because he rejects those around him. In reality, he is very cooperative and gentle with everyone he meets.

The true protagonist of World's End Club, who was controlling the robot Reycho via remote control. Becomes the official protagonist once the Reycho robot is disabled. An artificial intelligence created by MAIK initially programmed to infiltrate the Go-Getter's Club, he eventually sided with his friends to stop MAIK. He is an X-TYPE able to communicate with the Otherworlder (the Player).

A fan of the Hosekizuka Troupe, her dream is to one day become a member. She has elegance, beauty, and dignity that always shine brightly over her peers. Although she may epitomize beauty, Jennu is also strong, brave, and more fearless that the boys. Despite being an elementary school student, she takes on the guardian role in the group and tries to look out for everyone. However, if you make fun of the Hosekizuka Troupe, she'll fly into a rage, and has brawled with others in the past.
Yuki is quiet and gentle. Her timid nature makes others want to protect her. Her fragile but pretty smile steals the heart of a certain boy.
She is fascinated by things she has never seen before.
From official site

Yuki is the third personality that composes MAIK, the A.I. antagonist. However, she developed her own robotic body and joined the Go-Getters Club, wishing to become friends with them as they oppose MAIK.

Facilitates, judges, and explains the Game of Fate to the protagonists. Pielope is always high strung, flipping back and forth between menacing and playful, much to the annoyance of Reycho and the other Go-Getters. It often gets carried away easily, doing things its own way, and is impulsive, mean-spirited, cruel, and violent. While not getting directly involved, it tries to stir things up and liven up the Game of Fate, fanning the flames and attempting to have the Go-Getters Club fight it out. Always elusive, Pielope appears at unexpected moments to say its piece before quickly vanishing again. What is Pielope's true form? What are its intentions behind the Game of Fate?
From official site
Initially created by Vanilla to moderate the Game of Fate, MAIK took over the robot's programming and implanted in its third personality in order to hunt down the Go-Getters.
A self-generated consciousness created within the robot Reycho, carrying the robot's memories of the Go-Getters' adventures and friendship.

A transdimensional being that watches over the events of World's End Club. They can communicate with Pochi, an X-TYPE, and assists him in the Go-Getters' adventures across Japan. They give subliminal instructions to the Go-Getters when they're in trouble, and they're able to travel through time and witness alternate histories, gathering clues and avoiding the Go-Getters' deaths.
The Otherworlder represents the Player in the story.
A mysterious God that Master and his survivor group in Ehime all revere.

MAIK is an artificial intelligence created by Nyoro's Dad, which determined that in order to save life on Earth it must control the human race and subjugate them of their emotions. MAIK chose the Go-Getters Club as "Shepherds" that would lead the "Sheep", due to their intolerance to the emotion-suppressing nano-machines.
MAIK is composed of 3 different personalities: the main MAIK personality, the Yuki personality that defies MAIK, and a third personality implanted into Pielope.
Master is the leader of a cult located in the ruins of the Ehime Prefecture. His cult reveres a god named MAIK, who seemingly saved them from the apocalypse.
Master follows MAIK's orders in its Human Sheepification Project, and he may have been brainwashed by MAIK.
Kansai's baseball coach, who taught him how to be a leader and a real man.
He is the fiancé of Jennu's older sister, and he feels guilty due to her death while she was visiting him in Kyoto. He managed to survive the apocalypse but was brainwashed by MAIK.
Nyoro's father, a scientist.
He created the artificial intelligence MAIK, inadvertently causing the end of the world.
Jennu's older sister, who passed away during an earthquake in Kyoto when visiting her fiancé, Niyan.
